trigger.script: local music = random (5) if music == 1 then PlayCustomMusic("WotBattle01") elseif music == 2 then PlayCustomMusic("WotBattle02") elseif music == 3 then PlayCustomMusic("WotBattle03") elseif music == 4 then PlayCustomMusic("WotBattle04") else PlayCustomMusic("WotBattle05") end
